## How tested
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run compat:check`

## Checklist
- [ ] Conventional-commit PR title
- [ ] No writes to real user state in tests
- [ ] Docs/README updated if behavior changed
